format: WSDC Registry Events, posted contest results

source.edition: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
source.quote_free_summary: Results (rounds, placements, score reports) are posted at the event and stay open to all competitors for at least 30 days; inaccurate results require corrected results to be posted.

requirement: A post-completion correction never hides the current published result; a corrected version supersedes it only when published; no automatic expiry.
interpretation_notes: Whether a corrected result restarts the 30 days is NOT SPECIFIED; the design applies a conservative DanceFlow policy and labels it as such. Design only (PR-A): nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
